{{Location Infobox |image = IridiumQuarry |address = West of the [[Crimson Badlands]] |occupants = }} '''Iridium Quarry''' is a [[Locations|location]] found west of [[Crimson Badlands]]. Many iridium nodes and meteorites appear in the area.
